description: Change one of the person's job alerts by its id. Read its current search from list_subscriptions and pass only what changes — every field is optional: name; the search (query, filters, salary_min, salary_max — each replaces that part, an empty filters object clears the facet filters, a salary bound of 0 clears it; website-only filters in `other` are kept); channels (the full set to deliver on — added ones must be connected, missing ones stop); paused (true stops every channel, false resumes them — prefer it to unsubscribe for holding an alert). The new search must still narrow the catalogue, and unknown values are dropped and named in ignored_params. e.g. remote senior Go roles in the EU paying at least 80k EUR is {"filters":{"work_mode":["remote"],"seniority":["senior"],"skills":["go"],"regions":["eu"],"salary_currency":["EUR"]},"salary_min":80000}. Digest timing is account-wide and not changed here. A removed channel's record of matches is deleted with it.

channels.description: The complete set of channels to deliver on.

filters.description: Facet filters by param name (skills, seniority, category, work_mode, regions, countries, cities, metros, company_slug, employment_type, salary_currency, source, …), each a list of values. An unknown filter name is refused.

id.description: The alert id, from list_subscriptions or subscribe.

paused.description: true pauses every channel, false resumes them.

query.description: Free-text query, with the job search's operators.

salary_max.description: Only postings whose stated salary ceiling is at most this. 0 clears it on update.

salary_min.description: Only postings whose stated salary floor is at least this, in the posting's currency — pair it with filters.salary_currency. 0 clears it on update.

name: update_subscription
